description: This Kotlin source file defines the singleton object 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction' which provides utility functions related to processing user actions and constructing messages for UI interaction in the OpenClaw application. It includes methods for extracting action names from JSON objects, sanitizing string tags, formatting agent messages with contextual data, and creating JavaScript code snippets for dispatching UI action status events.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the 'name' or 'action' field from a JSON user action object, trimming whitespace and returning null if empty.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string value for use as a tag by trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Constructs a formatted string message with various sanitized parameters and optional context JSON for UI communication.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript string that dispatches a custom event indicating the status of a UI action, with success or error information.

methods.name: jsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in JSON, replacing certain Unicode characters.
